purpose: Simultaneous horizontal (x or y) and vertical (z) sine excitation at 0.5-0.75 of each resonance with a non-integer frequency ratio, so that the OptiTrap coupling parameter vzr in F_z = az*sin(vz*dz)*cos(vzr*d_r) appears in the recorded response. Reference: G:/マイドライブ/Experiment/20260917/measurement_plan/VZR_MEASUREMENT_PLAN.md (copied to vzr_identification_20260917/REFERENCE_VZR_MEASUREMENT_PLAN.md).
escalation_note: Every run is a continuous command with a 0.5 s raised-cosine ramp at both ends, 10 kHz, exactly reproducing the plan's reference NPZ files (make_vzr_trajectory.py, phases x/y 0.0 rad and z 0.7 rad). Record the single-axis hold checks (*_only, 4 s) before the first combined run of each series, then escalate L1 -> L2 -> L3 -> L4 in this order; the simulation escaped at x 0.8 mm @ 57 Hz and x 0.7 mm @ 57 Hz keeps only a thin margin. The y+z series (Y1y -> Y1 -> Y2) checks the axisymmetric assumption. ALT is an optional fallback with more physical margin (x 0.7 mm @ 50 Hz). safety_limits are the Plan B values |v| <= 400 mm/s and |a| <= 400,000 mm/s^2; a multitone command above them is rejected at generation instead of being rescaled. Delay feedforward is OFF; the identification treats the trap as u(t - tau) and fits tau per run.

experiments.note: Single-axis retention check before L1: x 0.4 mm @ 57 Hz only, 4 s.
experiments.operator_checkpoint: confirm the particle is stable at centre and visible in both cameras; this run only checks x-axis retention

experiments.name: vzr_L1z_z0.15_187Hz_only

experiments.operator_checkpoint: confirm retention after both single-axis checks before the first combined run

experiments.operator_checkpoint: confirm retention after L1 before escalating

experiments.operator_checkpoint: confirm retention after L3 before escalating

experiments.note: Single-axis retention check before Y1: y 0.5 mm @ 55 Hz only, 4 s. y is the depth axis (about 3x the observation noise of x).
experiments.operator_checkpoint: confirm retention after the x+z series; this run only checks y-axis retention

experiments.note: Stage Y1 (recommended): y 0.5 mm @ 55 Hz + z 0.20 mm @ 187 Hz, 8 s. Axisymmetry check: vzr from y+z should agree with vzr from x+z within about 10%.
experiments.operator_checkpoint: confirm retention after the y-only check before the first y+z run
